approach: Use the supplied references for features, not wholesale borrowing of their entire grammars or sound systems. Aza'raan canon controls conflicts.

primary.name: Letter Evolution Table.docx
facts: Kaʻaheʻanua is Proto-Polynesian-derived; Uxrowoiye is shaped primarily by Khmer speech with a lesser Italian influence
Aza'raan emerges from their merger after the 1351 BCE convergence
Approximately 90 percent of grammar uses particles
Preferred SVO with particle-governed order flexibility
Most words end in vowels; some consonant-final words survive
Historical sound inventory grouped into 13 sound families
Historic glottal ʼ, click ¡, emphasis > and < are not base letters

attached_references.name: Māori language - Wikipedia(1).pdf
attached_references.design_use: Open syllables V, VV, CV, CVV; mora and vowel length; particles, flexible focus and verbal predicates, pronoun number and inclusivity

attached_references.name: Khmer script - Wikipedia(20261029-041352).pdf
attached_references.design_use: Abugida-like consonant bases, dependent vowels, coeng-style stacked subscript representation; Khmer Unicode block

attached_references.name: Malayalam script - Wikipedia(8).pdf
attached_references.design_use: Independent/dependent vowels, consonant joining and subscript shapes, syllabic composition

attached_references.name: Georgian scripts - Wikipedia(20261029-041412).pdf
attached_references.design_use: Historically distinct letterforms and retained letter identity across evolving scripts

attached_references.name: Tengwar - Wikipedia(20261029-041352).pdf
attached_references.design_use: Separating base signs and phonetic marks; mode-dependent orthography. Inspiration only, not copied glyphs

attached_references.name: Khoisan languages - Wikipedia(1).pdf
attached_references.design_use: Click articulations and contrastive phoneme treatment; avoid treating Khoisan as a single established language family

attached_references.name: French language - Wikipedia(1).pdf
attached_references.design_use: Vowel quality, front vowels, nasal effects and historical spelling change as possible sound-development inspirations

attached_references.name: Italian language - Wikipedia(1).pdf
attached_references.design_use: Gemination and vowel-ending tendencies; not imported as Italian grammar

attached_references.name: German language - Wikipedia(1).pdf
attached_references.design_use: Consonant contrasts, cluster repair and historical sound alternation as optional influences

distinction.attested: Specified by the user or the attached evolution table
distinction.derived: A direct structural consequence of an attested rule
distinction.proposed: A newly authored Aza'raan system rule or example not previously canonized
